title: Comparison of extension by zero with the site morphism
statement:
Let $\nu_X:X_{\Proet}\to X_{\Et}$ be the comparison morphism of
[def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For an open immersion
$j:U\hookrightarrow X$ and a finite commutative ring $\Lambda$ the
canonical comparison

$$
\nu_X^*j^{\mathrm{et}}_!F\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }j^{\mathrm{proet}}_!\nu_U^*F
$$

is an isomorphism for every sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on
$U_{\Et}$, naturally in $F$ and compatible with composition of
open immersions; here the two $j_!$ are those of
[def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and
[def-weil-extension-by-zero].

proof.text: Use the existing canonical natural isomorphism openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso. Its components are invertible by the natural-isomorphism API, and its naturality is already part of its type. Its definition is the inverse conjugate of comparisonLowerStarOpenImmersionRestrictionIso, the identity comparison on sections. No new inverse is chosen.

Define the literal composition comparisons of restrictions on both sites using Over.mapComp and sheafPushforwardContinuousComp. Compute their conjugates across restriction/pushforward adjunctions on sections: both give lowerStarComp. Injectivity of conjugateEquiv then identifies upperStarComp followed by the two restriction identifications with the direct restriction identification followed by restriction composition. The etale calculation reuses Etale.upperStarComp_hom_comp_upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction; the pro-etale calculation is proved by pullback.hom_ext. The identity version uses Over.mapId and pullbackId and is proved by the same conjugation argument.

Prove elementary transport formulas for conjugation and composite adjunctions by their units and naturality. They show that the exact public extension-composition definitions, Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekComp and proEtaleOpenExtensionComp, transpose to the inverses of the literal restriction-composition comparisons from the preceding step. Likewise the exact leftAdjointIdIso maps transpose to the inverses of identity restriction.

Apply adjunctionSquareComposition to the three comparison adjunctions and the etale and pro-etale extension adjunctions. Each comparison mate identity is the defining apply_symm_apply equality. For its right-adjoint pasting hypothesis evaluate on a pro-etale sheaf and an etale site object. The two comparison maps are identities; the remaining two Over.mapComp arrows cancel, since both have identity underlying scheme morphism. This proves the pasted equality of natural isomorphisms.

Evaluate the inverse of the pasted equality at F and cancel the two extension-composition isomorphisms; a generic categorical cancellation lemma avoids unfolding the extension constructions. For identities, conjugate both routes, use the unitors and the identity-restriction mate computations, and evaluate the resulting equality at F. All section calculations and adjunction identities apply to empty schemes and zero coefficient rings without case restrictions.
